title: A2ZERO Week: Guided Tree Walk - Buhr Park
description: Registration required. Join the Office of Sustainability and Innovations for a guided version of our Buhr Park Neighborhood Tree Walk, beginning at the Buhr Park Pool (2751 Packard St). Learn about the trees in the neighborhood, some of the history they've witnessed, and the benefits they provide to our community. Bring sunscreen and water and be prepared to learn all about Buhr Park’s trees! Please note that this event is active and will involve extended periods of standing and walking on paved, but occasionally uneven, surfaces. Can't make this guided version of the tree walk? Check out our self-guided version, plus 12 other self-guided tree walks, at www.a2gov.org/10ktrees.

title: A2ZERO Week: Michigan Animal Protection Laws
venue: 3100 Cherry Hill Rd, Ann Arbor, MI 48105
description:
Ever wondered how Michigan protects animals, who steps in when something goes wrong, and how well the system works? Join Attorneys for Animals for a frank evaluation of Michigan's animal protection laws, the agencies that enforce them, and how cruelty and neglect is addressed in the state. We'll break down key legal terms, explore the difference between neglect and cruelty, and touch on how federal law fits in. It's an engaging overview of Michigan's animal protection laws, highlighting what's working and what advocates still need to do. Opening remarks from the City of Ann Arbor's Office of Sustainability and Innovations highlight how donating used textiles, such as blankets, contributes to climate action and helps animals.

Registration required at the link below.

title: A2ZERO Week: Circularity Party
venue: 25 Jackson Industrial Dr #500, Ann Arbor, MI 48103
description:
Swing by BYOC Co. on the Friday of A2ZERO Week for a Circularity Party! This special event will feature ways to "green" your consumption and participate in our local circular economy, including:
  • Free relish tasting and live pickling demonstration with local circular economy cannery, C'mon Betty
  • Free "Build-Your-Own Quick Pickle Kits" provided by A2ZERO (while supplies last)
  • Free bags of climate-friendly, plant-based food when you sign up for VegMichigan's 30-Day Plant-Based Pledge Program
  • Free Spice Blend Sampling and Pop-up Shop by Smiling Jim's Organic Seasonings
  • Prize drawings, giveaways, and discounts to help you live more sustainably
And, of course, bring your own containers to shop BYOC Co.'s wide selection of refillable eco-friendly personal care and household cleaning products! We hope to see you there!

Learn how to make a fire. Once you have learned, you will build your own fire! We will be cooking over the main fire to make fries. Materials for fire building and fry making will be provided, but make sure to bring water, layers, sunscreen, and anything else you might want. title: Monthly Clothing Swap
venue: Larcom City Hall, City Council Chambers, 2nd Floor
description:
Join the Office of Sustainability and Innovations for monthly clothing swaps on the third Thursday of each month! These are a perfect way to give your gently used clothes a new home. And you might just find an item of clothing you have been looking for, without having to buy it new.

​​How it works: Each person can bring up to 5 items of clothing in good condition (no rips, holes, stains, or unwashed items please!). Accessories are also welcome. You can take clothing without bringing anything, or bring clothing without taking anything. This is a completely free event.
